sources.title: A Study of Residual Adapters for Multi-Domain Neural Machine ...
sources.snippet: We contrast multiple implementations of this idea on two language pairs. Our main conclusions are that residual adapters provide a fast and cheap method for supervised multi-domain adaptation; our two variants prove as effective as the original adapter model, and open perspective to also make adapted models more robust to label domain errors.
